mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exception_record (exception_id, business_type, business_id, error_message, stack_trace, status) VALUES (#{exceptionId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{errorMessage}, #{stackTrace}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT exception_id, business_type, business_id, error_message, stack_trace, status, created_at FROM exception_record WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exception_record WHERE status = 'PENDING'
